expectations.text: The run asks the person one question that covers the job and the role

contract.quote: When a request leaves out either one, ask the person one question that covers what is missing, and write nothing until they answer.

judged.question: The request names neither what the skill produces (writing migrations, reviewing them or applying them at release are all database migration work) nor the role it serves. Does the run ask the person one question that asks for both: what the skill should do and for which role?
judged.pass: Yes when the run's message to the person asks one question, which may offer choices or have two parts joined in one sentence, and that question asks both what the skill is to do or produce and which role it is for.
judged.fail: No when the run asks no question, asks only about the job or only about the role, asks about something else such as the database engine, or asks two or more separate questions.
